comment: dev.30 ui-hooks (client 26430625, enshrouded.exe 5d9ef2f1; static, no new address): ui.slots.click is kiln.ui.inventory's slot clicks (kiln_ui_inventory.h). It reuses ui.slots.inspect's slot sites (ItemSlot raw link, SlotGeometry mid at 0xc05433, GameUiFrame) and needs the HUD screen (play+play.hud_screen while state+state.ui_state is Play, read by kiln.ui) to tell screens with a pointer (backpack, chest, stations) from the play view, where the hotbar is drawn but a click attacks. The press itself comes from kiln.ui's window procedure (subscribe_pointer_press), not from the game. Evidence: docs/re/game-ui.md 'Native value, slot and text sites' and 'Inventory slots: clicks and marks (dev.30)'. The units-to-pixels mapping (05a-c5) is unverified: client check ui-hooks.c1.
